must: Two faces only: DFVN Some Time Later (display) + Alexandria (everything read)
Display type never set below 1.0 — Vietnamese diacritics need the headroom
Teal is surface/ornament only; --color-wave-ink is the only teal that carries text
Header hides on scroll down and returns on scroll up (8px threshold, held open while a drawer is open)
Hero loop opens on the Ti Coolture frame, then shop-submitted 16:9 landscape frames with attribution
Every shop image slot is landscape (16:9, >=1600px); an unfilled slot renders as a labelled block, never stock photography
District map is a carousel, one map per district; tapping a marked point lists the route starting there
For him / For her collections present on the homepage
Price note and the no-transaction disclaimer appear verbatim wherever they apply
prefers-reduced-motion stops every looping and scroll-driven animation
Only the six brand tokens in src/index.css; no new colours
Colour ratio 60% violet / 30% black and white / 10% teal (user confirmed 2026-08-19)
avoid: Cart, checkout, price-as-final, or any language implying Ti Coolture sells
Invented shop names, testimonials, press or user counts beyond the labelled seed data
Shadows outside modals — hairlines carry structure

decisions.question: Which of the three homepage directions does the team take forward?

axes.navigation: chrome thins to a hairline index
axes.catalogue: numbered index rows, hover summons the plate
two counter-running marquee lanes (from A), cardless
axes.howItWorks: four cards overlapping ~27%, revealing in sequence on scroll (after dontboardme.com)
axes.collections: four numbered placeholders on a pinned 60/30/10 sliding track
axes.map: single strip; island + pins + arrows, the map itself links to /kham-pha
axes.footer: MO-4 reveal — stationary underlay, wordmark scrubs 0.25 to 1
axes.colour: violet-dominant per the 60/30/10 guideline; one white section (How it works), one ink section (map), teal reserved for indices, the island and one collection panel
axes.hiddenGems: right-edge tab ported from the live homepage; hides on scroll-down with the rest of the chrome per UX-TASKS 2.3

decisions.onDecide: Delete the two unchosen src/lab/Direction*.tsx files and their routes in src/App.tsx, fold the winner into src/views/Homepage.tsx, and set this decision to the chosen slug.
decisions.note: 19/08: team chose C as the base for its cardless feel, and asked for A's marquee and collection look to be brought across. A and B stay published for reference; C is now the working direction.

PRODUCT.md records the guidelines ratio as 60% white / 30% violet / 10% teal; the header comment in src/index.css records it as violet 60% / white 30% / teal 10%. Direction B reads it the PRODUCT.md way (paper ground), A and C the index.css way (violet ground). Confirm against docs/BRAND-GUIDELINES-TI-COOLTURE.pdf before committing to a direction.
decisions.resolution: User confirmed: 60% violet, 30% black and white, 10% teal. Violet is the dominant ground. Direction C was retoned to match; measured across 2660 sample points over the full page: violet 52%, white 14%, ink 12%, teal 9%, photography 13% (the hero photo carries a violet multiply scrim, so perceived violet sits near 60%).

decisions.question: Should the pinned collections window run one step further so every collection gets its 60% moment?
decisions.note: The brief described the window sliding from (C1 60, C2 30, C3 10) to (Cn-2 60, Cn-1 30, Xem them 10), which is what ships. With four collections that means Collection 4 peaks at 30% and never reaches 60%. One-line change in PinnedCollections: cursorMax = panelCount - 2 instead of panelCount - 3.

wireframes.html MO-7 says the collections pin 'releases directly into the footer reveal - the two are consecutive, never simultaneous'. The team's 19/08 note puts the map strip between collections and the footer, which ships. The two are still consecutive, just with the strip between them; confirm this supersedes the wireframe note.

decisions.question: How much structural work should the identity marks do on the homepage?
decisions.sharedBase: Direction C. All three studies are the same page; only the device layer differs (src/lab/brandLayers.tsx).
decisions.source: docs/BRAND-GUIDELINES-TI-COOLTURE.pdf p13 (ratio), p15 (ribbon + arc), p16 (wave), p17 (restraint)

axes.arc: static, bled off the hero corner, clear of the wordmark
axes.wave: the real brand-wave-bottom at every seam, teal crest line
axes.ribbon: static, astride the hero seam as on the cover

axes.arc: rotates with scroll - the mark for connection reports progress
axes.wave: crest drifts as the section passes
axes.ribbon: draws itself in on first sight

axes.wave: the catalogue rides the crest; page progress is a rising tide
axes.ribbon: the negative-space eye becomes an aperture onto the next hero frame
axes.note: derived from what the book says the marks mean, not from its drawings

decisions.onDecide: Keep the chosen variant's layer, delete the other two branches in src/lab/brandLayers.tsx, and fold it into DirectionC as the default.

decisions.note: Guidelines p13 states the ratio as 60% violet #7520F7 / 30% white #FFFFFF / 10% teal #39D6CF. There is no black in the ratio. Direction C currently spends part of its 30% on ink grounds (the map strip, one collection panel). The brand studies deliberately leave those alone so the comparison isolates the device layer. Decide whether the ink grounds should become white to match the book.
